name: companion-party-overhaul
author: Always
description: Your companions as a real party of people who live in this world with you. Companion Life and Companion Tactics in one. How they fight: each class in its part, the way players play: auto-attacks normally and SP saved for the bad moments, healers that heal the right one at the right time, casters that freeze and burst, the back line protected, with orders in party chat and the items you give them. How they grow: builds like real players, gear refined as they level, transcendent when you are. How they live: they talk (greetings, reactions, callouts, about 200 conversations that grow from strangers to close friends), remember your adventures, stand around loosely between fights, look around, and sit beside the one they feel closest to. A Companions window (Alt+N) shows their status, memories, bags (with a weight bar and a restock list they shop for in town), the gear you gave and their colours, and a Loot tab: the party purse and the party bag, where everything they find on your trips goes. Options are grouped in the Settings window.

settings.label: Party spacing: Close
settings.description: Between fights they stand within 2 cells of you and follow once you are 3 away. Pick one spacing in the Settings window; none = the game's own tight follow. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: Party spacing: Normal
settings.description: Between fights they stand within 4 cells of you and follow once you are 5 away. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: Party spacing: Far
settings.description: Between fights they stand within 6 cells of you and follow once you are 7 away. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: They look around while you wait
settings.description: While you stand still and nothing is fighting, every 12-30 seconds one companion strolls a few steps to another spot near you, as people do. Archers, hunters, bards, dancers and gunslingers walk a patrol lap around the party instead, rest, and go round again.

settings.label: Sit down when you wait
settings.description: After a minute with no monster in sight (three for the scouts), each walks over to the one it's most comfortable with (you, or a friend) and sits facing them. Once they've sat a while, one now and then gets up to look around or shift spot. They get up when a monster shows up or you walk off, and sit again once you've stood still a few seconds. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: Campfire nights
settings.description: Say "make camp" in party chat, or yes when a companion offers after you've stood still a while. A bonfire, everyone round it, campfire talks, a meal cooked from food in your bags (a 30-minute party buff), and Well Rested (+10% base EXP, faster regen) once you leave after 5+ minutes. "time to go" puts it out. Needs Orders in party chat. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: Party roles
settings.description: Fights played like players: auto-attacks normally, SP saved for bad moments (3+ monsters, the back line hit, someone under 50%, a boss). Melee kite 3+ round the Priest, archers step back and burst, hunters trap only to guard, casters freeze and burst. Healers: full Heal under 50%, Kyrie the tank, then under 80%. The back line comes first. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: Orders in party chat
settings.description: Type in party chat: "assist me"/"focus", "free fight", "regroup", "heal me", "buff me", "kyrie me", "wall me", "land protector", "aoe", "trap", "take a break", "let's go", "go hunt" and "come back" (roaming needs the app's Companion roaming; add a name for just that one). Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: Use the items you give them
settings.description: Needs Settings > Population > Companion inventory on. They cure poison, silence, blind, curse and confusion (Green Herb, Green Potion, Holy Water, Panacea, Royal Jelly), use Yggdrasil Seed or Berry under 20% HP while hit, revive the fallen (you too) with Yggdrasil Leaves when no Priest can, and drink their class's speed potion near a boss. Cheapest first. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: No buffing in town
settings.description: With no monster in sight (towns, inns) companions don't cast buffs, songs or stances. Once a monster is in sight they buff as usual. Say "buff" in party chat to have them buff you anyway. Heals and revives always work. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: Roam as a group
settings.description: When you send them hunting ("go hunt"), the whole party sticks to the tank and roams as one group: no resting on the way, 3+ on one and it calls for help, the hurt kite round the Priest, and they gather at a fallen one for the revive. Off: each roams on its own, the way the game does it. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: What companions call you
settings.description: One or more titles, separated by commas. Each companion keeps one of them, so some call you Boss and others Captain.

settings.label: Everyday chatter
settings.description: They greet you at login by how long you were away, comment when you enter a town, field or dungeon and when you level up, cheer their own level-ups and job changes, say when they rest and are ready again, notice when you go quiet, talk about the late night or early morning, suggest a break after two hours, and mention what went into the party purse.

settings.label: Combat callouts and emotes
settings.description: Battle cries, calls for heals, low SP, big hits, a fallen ally, you in danger, spotting and beating a boss, the undead, bad statuses, thanks for Blessing and Agi Up, broken gear, with RO emotes (HP!, SP!, sweat, tears; at most one every 12 seconds each). Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: They answer you in party chat
settings.description: Say something in party chat and your companions answer in character: hello, good morning, good night, thanks, good job, let's go, how are you, lol, brb, I'm back, sorry, love you, take a break, who are you, hungry. Changing this restarts the server.

settings.label: Minutes between companion conversations
settings.description: Roughly how often companions talk with each other when nothing is going on (or muse to you, if there is only one), varying by 30%. With three or more companions they talk 40% more often, mostly as a group. Topics depend on who's talking, where you are, the hour, a boss just beaten and their memories. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: Companion chat colour
settings.description: The colour of your companions' lines in the chat box, so they stand out from other players: 0 white (as before), 1 sky blue, 2 mint, 3 gold, 4 pink, 5 lavender. The words over their heads stay white.

settings.label: Party purse: zeny per monster level, per companion
settings.description: Every monster you beat puts this much zeny per monster level into the party purse, for each living companion with you (2 = a level 40 monster with 3 companions adds 240 zeny). The monster's drops still go to you, so this is on top. Take it out (or put zeny in) in the Companions window's Loot tab. It also pays for restocking in town. 0 turns the purse off.

settings.label: Loot finds
settings.description: A monster the party beats (yours or a companion's) can also turn up one thing from its own drop list, into the party bag (Loot tab, no weight limit): Take it or Sell it into the purse. 0 off, 1 Low (a tenth of its drop rate), 2 Normal (a quarter), 3 Generous (half).

settings.label: Gifts from companions
settings.description: Now and then a companion walks over and gives you something that suits it: potions, gemstones, arrows, Holy Water, a bit of zeny, rarely an Oridecon, a Yggdrasil Leaf or an Old Blue Box, very rarely an Old Card Album. Closer companions give more often; a bigger party, more gifts. Also sometimes after an MVP, a level-up or an anniversary.

settings.label: Starter kit for unequipped companions
settings.description: A companion drafted with the app's Companions start unequipped (Settings > Population) gets NPC-shop gear for its class and level, once: weapon (with arrows or bullets), hat, armor, shield, garment, shoes. It's yours, like anything you give it: take it back, swap it or sell it. Nothing is ever replaced on its own.

settings.label: Memories
settings.description: Each companion remembers your time together: the day and place you met, monsters and MVPs beaten together (your kills while they're with you), places seen, times fallen. They bring it up now and then, and celebrate milestones and anniversaries. Kept with your character.

settings.label: Companions grow like players
settings.description: Stats like a real player of their class (an Assassin AGI and STR, a Wizard INT and DEX). Worn gear refined as they level: +4 at 40, +5 at 55, +6 at 70, +7 at 85, more past 99 (gear you gave comes back refined). Transcendent when you are, level kept. Broken gear repaired and put back on.

settings.label: Fallen companions return when you leave the map
settings.description: While you stay on the map, a fallen companion stays down until a Priest or a Yggdrasil Leaf brings it back. Once you leave (go back to town, warp, or respawn at your save point), it gets back up with full HP and SP and rejoins you. Fixes the game's bug where it stayed dead until you relogged.

settings.label: Tell me how they grow
settings.description: A line in your chat box when a companion trains its stats (before and after), gets its gear refined, is reborn, has broken gear repaired, and when one you left behind gets back up and comes after you.

settings.label: Companions button
settings.description: A small Companions button on screen (drag it anywhere) that opens the Companions window: everyone's HP, SP, level and state, a Memories tab, a Bag tab (each companion's bag, weight, gear you gave, restock list, outfit and hair colour) and a Loot tab (the party purse and the party bag). Alt+N opens it too, with or without the button.
